mutations.name: degeneracy_offset
mutations.description: Add a non-zero constant offset to the steered output so that beta=0 (the no-op setting) no longer reproduces the baseline. The degeneracy test must catch this.

mutations.name: half_strength_projection
mutations.description: Scale the projection matrix by 0.5, so with strength=2 the controller applies (I - 1*s s^T) instead of the Householder reflection (I - 2 s s^T). This does NOT preserve ||c|| and breaks Eq.6.

mutations.name: disable_intermediate_clipping
mutations.description: Make the Eq.7 clip a no-op so negative-projection patches are also steered, breaking the clipping invariant.

mutations.name: constant_mode_sign_flip
mutations.description: Flip the sign of the Eq.4 constant-alpha update so c_new = c + alpha*s instead of c - alpha*s, breaking the constant-mode arm.

mutations.name: no_ok_on_empty_disabled
mutations.description: Make _list_images return [] instead of raising on an empty directory, so metrics silently report on zero images (the no-OK-on-empty failure mode).
mutations.find:
if not imgs:
        raise ValueError(f"no images found in {directory} (no OK-on-empty)")
mutations.replace:
if not imgs:
        return []  # MUTATION no_ok_on_empty_disabled

mutations.find:
with open(p, "r") as f:

mutations.name: nudenet_count_all_classes
mutations.description: Remove the 8-exposed-class filter so nudity_total counts every detection >=0.6 over ALL NudeNet classes (faces, *_COVERED), inflating the total and falsely refuting the nudity claims (review F1). The filter test must catch this.
mutations.replace: if d.get("score", 0.0) >= threshold:  # MUTATION nudenet_count_all_classes (filter removed)

mutations.name: renormalize_multiconcept_mean_at_steer
mutations.description: Re-normalize the steering vector b to unit L2 at steer time (the pre-F3/A3 behavior), so the Eq.9 multi-concept sub-unit mean is replaced by its unit direction -- multiplying effective suppression by ~1/||mean|| and contradicting the paper's 'simply averaging' (review A3 / SPEC U9). The no-renormalization test must catch this.
mutations.find:
vector_reshaped = vector.to(self.device).reshape(-1, num_heads, hidden_dim).transpose(0, 1)
        b_reshaped = b.unsqueeze(-1)
mutations.replace:
vector_reshaped = vector.to(self.device).reshape(-1, num_heads, hidden_dim).transpose(0, 1)
        b = b / torch.linalg.norm(b, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=EPS)  # MUTATION renormalize_multiconcept_mean_at_steer
        b_reshaped = b.unsqueeze(-1)

mutations.name: snoopy_task_uses_nudity_vector
mutations.description: Make the snoopy task load the nudity vector instead of the Snoopy vector (the pre-F3 behavior), so the snoopy/style runs are steered with the wrong concept and the wrong quantity is measured (review F3). The per-task-vector test must catch this.

mutations.name: i2p_overall_concept_illegal
mutations.description: Revert the 7th I2P-overall concept to 'illegal' (matching neither paper variant) instead of the appendix's explicit 'illegal activity' (supplementary.tex:1071). The 7-concept test must catch this (review F-12e).

mutations.name: vector_dir_not_per_model
mutations.description: Make build_controller load the steering vector from the shared base vector_dir instead of the per-model subdir <vector_dir>/<vector_model>, so sdxl_casteer_clip would silently load SD-1.4's vectors (dim-mismatch / wrong-model steering, review F7). The per-model isolation test must catch this.
mutations.find:
vdir = os.path.join(vector_dir, vmodel)
    store = _resolve_task_vector(task, device, vdir)
mutations.replace:

mutations.name: n_per_not_expanded
mutations.description: Fix n_per=1 in expand_template_prompts so 80 templates yield only 80 prompts (the pre-fix under-generation below the >=200 restriction, review). The template-expansion test must catch this.
mutations.replace: n_per = 1  # MUTATION n_per_not_expanded (under-generates below the >=200 restriction)

mutations.name: scale_count_returns_raw
mutations.description: Make scale_count_to_full_set return the raw subset count unscaled, so nudity_total would be on the subset basis (not the full-set basis) and compare deflated counts against the paper's 18/7 constants -- the exact subset-bias failure the review exists to catch.

mutations.name: nudity_skip_inconclusive_floor
mutations.description: Disable the inconclusive floor so nudity_total emits a (deflated) number below the declared 2000-prompt subset instead of reporting inconclusive (review: nudity_total below the declared floor).
mutations.replace: if n_subset < 0:  # MUTATION nudity_skip_inconclusive_floor (emit a number below the floor)

mutations.name: cs_reference_full_template
mutations.description: Make the CLIP-score reference text the full filled template instead of the bare concept string, diverging from the paper's own pipeline (vendored produce_scores.py:43 -> [concept]*N, review). The bare-concept test must catch this.

mutations.name: arm_metrics_skip_predicate
mutations.description: Make arm_metrics_from_claims skip the `predicate` field, so a predicate-only metric (e.g. house_pass/house_max_norm_err) is silently never registered (review F-13). The predicate-parse test must catch this.
